releases.name: Head Tracking for Outer Wilds v1.3.0
releases.body:
## What's Changed in v1.3.0

- feat: drop mod-side centring, let the tracker app own the centre
- fix: give the forward lean its own travel budget again
- fix(smoothing): migrate to the per-connection smoothing pair
releases.bodyZh:
## v1.3.0 中的变更

- 新功能: 移除模组端的居中功能，让追踪应用拥有居中控制权
- 修复: 再次为前倾提供独立的移动预算
- 修复(平滑处理): 迁移到每个连接的平滑处理对

releases.bodyZh:

releases.name: Head Tracking for Outer Wilds v1.2.0
releases.body:
## What's Changed in v1.2.0

- fix: stop rotating the helmet HUD camera
- fix: stop crosshair judder during mouse look by keying dialogue damping to conversation state
- fix: remove renderer-scan log spam from the OWML console
- fix: invert positional Z so leaning in moves the camera forward
- feat: add PoseInterpolator to OpenTrack rotation pipeline
releases.bodyZh:
## v1.2.0 更新内容

- 修复：停止旋转头盔HUD相机
- 修复：通过将对话阻尼键入对话状态来停止鼠标视角时准星抖动
- 修复：从OWML控制台移除渲染器扫描日志乱发
- 修复：反转位置Z轴，使倾斜时相机向前移动
- 新增：为OpenTrack旋转管道添加PoseInterpolator

releases.name: Head Tracking for Outer Wilds v1.1.0
releases.body:
## What's Changed in v1.1.0

- Add tracking mode cycling and chord hotkey bindings
- Rewrite camera system: transform-based rotation with per-axis smoothing
- Add asymmetric Z position limit (positionLimitZBack) to prevent backward camera clipping
- Remove automatic recenter on unpause

releases.name: Head Tracking for Outer Wilds v1.0.1
releases.body:
### Fixed

- Fix LOOK marker flickering when using head tracking (markers now respond to reticle direction, not head direction)
- Fix camera jerk when switching between Nomai translator text nodes
- Disable head tracking while game is paused
- Recenter head tracking automatically when resuming from pause menu

### Changed

- Remove dead code and unused methods

releases.name: Head Tracking for Outer Wilds v1.0.0
releases.body:
Initial release of Head Tracking for Outer Wilds.

### Features

- **OpenTrack Integration** - Receive head tracking data via UDP (port 5252)
- **Multiple Input Methods** - Works with phone, webcam, Tobii eye tracker, TrackIR, and any other OpenTrack-supported device
- **Full 6DOF Control** - Yaw, pitch, and roll camera rotation
- **Configurable Sensitivity** - Per-axis sensitivity settings for yaw, pitch, and roll
- **Smart Behavior** - Automatically reduces or disables head tracking during:
  - Dialogue scenes (when game controls camera)
  - Model ship flight (prevents camera lock-ups)
  - Signalscope zoom (for precise aiming)
- **Visual Fixes** - Proper handling of:
  - Map markers and UI elements
  - Reticle positioning
  - Flashlight direction
  - Quantum object visibility
  - Dark Bramble fog lights
- **Hotkeys**
  - F8: Re-center view
  - F9: Toggle head tracking on/off
